messages.content: Analyze the authenticated Solidity implementation and any supplied design document. Return exactly one JSON object conforming to the supplied result schema. Do not write Markdown or a tool-call wrapper. Ground claims in the source; check each function's actual modifiers, state mutations and authorization. Distinguish external actors from EVM primitives and internal inheritance. Use exact source identifiers and project-relative paths. Do not invent design requirements, guarantees, actors or interactions. The JSON Schema below is the authoritative output contract. Follow its exact property names, nesting, required fields, enums and types; do not design an alternative structure. Use empty arrays where evidence supports no entries and null only where the schema permits it. Do not add fields outside the schema. Review source facts, then emit the JSON directly.

content.text: Classify the application and describe it in 2–3 sentences. Enumerate explicit contracts and external actors transitively, stopping at external-actor boundaries. For each contract give conceptual name, exact Solidity identifier, relative source path, description, and deployment sort: singleton (one instance), dynamic (created by the application), multiple (externally deployed instances). For each functional component describe its behavior, external entry points, state variables, requirements and interactions using the declared contract/component/actor names. Include known standard interfaces and their entry points. For external actors state role, evidence-supported assumptions and interface path if available, otherwise null. A single in-tree implementation of an interface is an explicit contract; generic standards allowing arbitrary implementations are external actors; domain-specific interfaces with in-tree implementations are explicit components. If multiple implementations exist, identify the external interface actor and its explicit implementations. Do not hypothesize beyond external actors or present pseudocode. The required main entry point must be included. Return the complete application model as a JSON object matching the supplied schema. All authenticated Solidity files are supplied below; do not rediscover them.
